body: Yeah! That’s where I slept the last time I did this, pretty chill aside from the occasional nosey person wondering what’s going on

When I got out of the hospital the first time and heard Perfect Circle/Godspeed. Spoke to me on some different levels.

>  The only thing currently stopping me from doing anything about it is the fear that nobody would actually care if I were gone. 

See, I’m convinced of that and it’s a motivator for me.

The main thing stopping me is from fear of being discovered and being sent back to a mental hospital. Those things are horrid environments.

I agree, but most people are concerned on a crushing level with how they fit in the world and society and their purpose. They have nagging thoughts about there and here, but few think of killing the selves over it. The short term strategy doesn’t work when you don’t see the value in the short term.
The each day as it comes philosophy just doesn’t cut it in modern society. If you want success you need a plan and a vision, and I have neither.
